_readme: Keyed by MLB player id (statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people/<id>). Per player: name, summary (contract text shown as-is), total (dollars), years, start, end, aav (dollars; defaults to total/years), seasons (year -> dollars; drives the per-season AAV button), tags (year -> non-dollar status like 'ARB 2' or 'FREE AGENT'), note, source.

660271.name: Shohei Ohtani
660271.note: Most of the deal is deferred, so the luxury-tax value is about $46.1M a year. Per-season figures here are the flat $70M AAV.
